description.zh: 让聊天里的 AI 像人一样犯困、睡着、做梦。睡着时你的消息按睡得深浅决定能不能叫醒他，叫不醒的醒来一起看。
description.en: Your AI companion gets drowsy, sleeps and dreams. While it sleeps, whether your message wakes it depends on how deeply it is sleeping; the rest is shown on waking.

description.zh: 绑定聊天、定时、查看状态和梦
description.en: Bind a chat, run the clock, see status and dreams
